svg.title: JH-Simple-Cucumber Skill Icon
svg.desc: Oree the duck takes on a cucumber-inspired form, waddling away with its back turned to the viewer. Beside Oree is a stylized version of the Gherkin cucumber logo, adapted to match the playful visual style of this skill icon.
svg.metadata:
Project: JH-Simple-Cucumber Project URL: https://github.com/JeongHan-Bae/JH-Toolkit
Purpose: A custom skill icon featuring Oree, the project's duck mascot, reimagined as a cucumber and paired with the Gherkin cucumber logo.
Design: A playful, cucumber-themed take on Oree, shown walking away alongside a stylized Gherkin cucumber logo.
